subject: executor: fix select wrong partition for hash partition table (#50045)
summary: Reviewed the planner change in `pkg/planner/core/rule_partition_processor.go` affecting hash partition pruning for non-point integer ranges. The adjustment to how negative bounds are mapped to partition indexes aligns pruning with expected `HASH(expr) PARTITIONS N` semantics for the reported case; no remaining Blocker/High issues found after checking subsequent upstream/master history.
